summary: Iteration 21: tested fluid inventory, Confirmar mezcla (Bitácora + exact bottle deduction), the signature on the mix-sheet PDF and the Historial de mezclas, on the backend and on the frontend (390x844). Backend: 11/11 new tests pass (test_iter21_inventory_mixconfirm.py) and 46/46 regression tests pass (iter18/19/20 and signature). Frontend: every requested flow passes. Inventory: plus/minus change stock by 1 (10→11→10), Fijar '0,5' gives 0.5 and shows 'existencia baja', minus at 0.5 gives 0 (never below 0), and the add form saves TEST_UIAdd21 with 30%, 946 mL and 4 botellas. The ref-inventory card opens /library/inventory. Wizard case with the TEST_UIFluid21 template (10 bottles, 473 mL): V1 0.75 L, 1.59 bottles. Tapping mix-confirm returns 200, adds 2 Bitácora entries with source 'mix' (Arterial TEST_UIFluid21 Index 25% 751 mL and Agua 8542 mL), shows the toast '−1.59 botellas, quedan 8.41' and the mix-confirmed text, and the inventory then reads 8.41. A second confirm returns 400 'Esta mezcla ya fue confirmada' and leaves stock unchanged. Reopening the wizard prefills only TEST_Coinj21; the Arterial/Agua mix entries are excluded. The mix-sheet PDF is 1 page, includes the technician name and signature caption when firma_tecnico exists and a blank line plus caption otherwise, and returns the confirmed flag. Stats shows the stats-mixes section with card stats-mix-2026-11 'Nov 2026 · 1 mezcla · 1.59 botellas'. Regression: mix-whatsapp opens wa.me and mix-pdf downloads Mezcla_TEST_iter21_ui.pdf. No deprecated Expo packages and no SafeAreaView-from-react-native imports found.

minor.issue: The confirm is check-then-act and not atomic: it reads mix_confirmed, deducts stock, then sets the flag. Two concurrent requests could both pass the check and deduct twice. 4 parallel calls did not reproduce it here (1x200, 3x400). Fix: put the condition in the update filter (calculations.$elemMatch {calc_id, mix_confirmed != true}) and deduct stock only if modified_count == 1.

If a fluid template exists but has no stock_bottles (created before the inventory feature), confirming sets stock to 0 and the toast says 'quedan 0'. Consider skipping the deduction or warning when stock was never set.
The delta update is read-modify-write, not $inc, so rapid +/- taps can lose an update. Low impact.

issues: 'Confirmar mezcla' is irreversible but has no confirmation dialog or undo. Deleting the mix Bitácora entries does not restore stock or clear the confirmed flag. Consider an Alert confirm step.
Fluids cannot be deleted from the inventory screen (only from the wizard's manage templates). Minor.

action_items: Optional: make mix-confirm atomic (conditional update on mix_confirmed != true before deducting stock).
Optional: use $inc for the stock delta in PATCH /fluids/{id}/stock.
Optional: add a confirmation Alert before 'Confirmar mezcla'; handle templates without stock_bottles (don't report 'quedan 0').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2260 lines and case/[id].tsx is 1184 lines; both are over the 700-line guideline and should be split into modules.
Stats mixes_by_month is derived from case calculations, so deleting a case also erases its mix history (stock is not restored). Acceptable, but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ fluids and cases, then deleted all of them by id (GET /api/fluids now returns an empty list, so there were no pre-existing user fluids). No user or seed data was modified.
